title_en: Near the Red School, 2+1 apartment for sale, with regular layout and perfect location!!
description_en: Near the Red School, 2+1 apartment for sale, with regular layout and perfect location!!! The property is located on the 6th floor of a building with 8 floors, and has a total area of ​​91 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom and 2 balconies. The property has regular mortgage documentation. The orientation of the property is West. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana and offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
